name: equivault
description: EquiVault - private allocation of scarce resources on Midnight

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @equivault/contract && npm run build --workspace @equivault/api && npm run build --workspace @equivault/ui
scripts.ci: npm run compact && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.compact: npm run compact --workspace @equivault/contract && npm run postcompact
scripts.proof-server: docker run -d --name equivault-proof-server -p 6300:6300 midnightntwrk/proof-server:8.1.0 midnight-proof-server --network testnet
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @equivault/contract && npm run test --workspace @equivault/api && npm run test --workspace @equivault/ui
